name: Halsin
lead: Halsin is a recruitable Companion who can be romanced by characters of any gender. He is a wood elf and a Circle of the Moon Druid with the Outlander background. Halsin can first be found in the Shattered Sanctum during Act One as an attached follower or as a camp follower .
You have Proficiency with Longswords , Shortswords , Longbows , and Shortbows .
